blocks.text: Dennis Trillo appeared to take another swipe at Patrick Garcia after a clip of the latter’s 2024 interview resurfaced, in which he described himself as a “dedicated” father. Garcia was interviewed on “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda” back in 2024 and was asked by show host Abunda to describe himself as a father. “Dedicated,” the actor answered, then called himself a “loving” husband and son.
